questions.question: What is the default scope of a Bean in the Spring IoC Container?
questions.explanation: By default, every Spring Bean has the 'singleton' scope (only a single shared instance exists per ApplicationContext).

questions.question: Which approach thoroughly resolves the N+1 Query problem in Spring Data JPA / Hibernate?
options: Increasing the database Connection Pool size
Using JOIN FETCH in JPQL or @EntityGraph to fetch the association in a single SQL query
Dropping foreign keys from the database table
questions.explanation: JOIN FETCH or @EntityGraph fetches both the parent and child entities in a single SQL JOIN query instead of executing N additional child queries.
questions.card_front: Which approach thoroughly resolves the N+1 Query problem in Spring Data JPA / Hibernate?
questions.card_back: Using JOIN FETCH in JPQL or @EntityGraph to fetch the association in a single SQL query
